name: Screen Recorder & Screenshot - MultiTab Studio
description: Record one tab, several tabs, a window or your whole screen as one continuous video. Plus region screenshots with a full editor.

capture-area.description: Screenshot: drag to select an area

capture-visible.description: Screenshot: the visible part of the page

capture-full.description: Screenshot: the whole page, scrolled and stitched

stop-recording.description: Stop the current recording (assign a key to use)

toggle-pause.description: Pause / resume the current recording (assign a key to use)

add-bookmark.description: Drop a bookmark on the recording timeline (assign a key to use)
